_market.en: Traffic light: SPY red (1 of 3 checks), QQQ green (3 of 3) — verdict avoid; breadth MIXED at score −3, T2108 22.3, 36.5% above the 200-day, 4 new highs against 42 new lows; Regime Damaged (37.5), system exposure “Reduced / selective”; themes 3 leading / 19 improving / 5 weakening / 3 lagging, all 10 leaders still holding.

RNG.zh: 组内六只里排位最高（第 99 百分位），离 21EMA 0.38 ATR，今年 EPS +221%。
RNG.en: Top of its six on group percentile (99th), 0.38 ATR from the 21EMA, EPS +221% this year.

ESTC.zh: 一个月 −0.7%，离高点 15.1%，离 21EMA 0.96 ATR，同组六只里回踩最浅。
ESTC.en: Down 0.7% in a month, 15.1% off its high, 0.96 ATR from the 21EMA — the shallowest pullback of its six.

AMPL.zh: 离 52 周高只差 6.2%，离 21EMA 0.83 ATR，一个月几乎没动（+0.1%）。
AMPL.en: Only 6.2% off its 52-week high, 0.83 ATR from the 21EMA, flat over the month (+0.1%).

DOCU.zh: 离 21EMA 只剩 0.11 ATR，同组六只里回踩最深，今年 EPS +33%。
DOCU.en: Just 0.11 ATR above the 21EMA, the deepest pullback of its six, EPS +33% this year.

SNOW.en: Up 6.2% in a month, 11.7% off its high, 0.54 ATR from the 21EMA, revenue +35%.

NICE.zh: 同组六只里 RS 与组内排位双双最低（45 / 第 74 百分位），离高点 23.5%，今年 EPS −53%。
NICE.en: Lowest of its six on both RS and group percentile (45 / 74th), 23.5% off its high, EPS −53% this year.

PBF.zh: 组内四只里排位最高（第 89 百分位），离 21EMA 0.7 ATR 是四只里最浅，营收 +56%。
PBF.en: Top of its four on group percentile (89th), 0.7 ATR from the 21EMA — the shallowest of the four — revenue +56%.

DINO.zh: 离 21EMA 只剩 0.27 ATR，同组四只里回踩最深，今年 EPS +350%。
DINO.en: Just 0.27 ATR above the 21EMA, the deepest pullback of its four, EPS +350% this year.

MPC.zh: 离 21EMA 0.35 ATR，一个月 +3.2%、今年 EPS +348%，和同组 DINO 几乎同步。
MPC.en: 0.35 ATR from the 21EMA, up 3.2% in a month, EPS +348% this year — tracking DINO almost exactly.

VLO.zh: 组内第 61 百分位，同组四只里最低；但一个月 +7.1%、今年 EPS +454% 都是四只里最高。
VLO.en: 61st percentile in its group, lowest of its four — yet its +7.1% month and +454% EPS are the highest of the four.

QRVO.zh: 一个月 +18.8%、离 52 周高只差 5.5%，同组三只里排位最高（第 96 百分位）；营收 −4%。
QRVO.en: Up 18.8% in a month, only 5.5% off its 52-week high, top of its three on group percentile (96th); revenue −4%.

DIOD.en: 23.2% off its 52-week high, close to §11.1's 25% line; up 11.1% in a month, 0.69 ATR from the 21EMA.

SIMO.en: Up 18% in a month but down 6.7% over three; 21% off its high, EPS +734% and revenue +127% this year.

W.zh: 一个月 +9.2%，离 21EMA 0.32 ATR、离 50SMA 只 0.59 ATR，离高点 14.5%。
W.en: Up 9.2% in a month, 0.32 ATR from the 21EMA and just 0.59 ATR above the 50SMA, 14.5% off its high.

GLBE.zh: 离 21EMA 0.33 ATR，和同组 W 位置几乎一样；但离 50SMA 只 0.29 ATR，更贴着下面那条线。
GLBE.en: 0.33 ATR from the 21EMA, almost exactly where W sits; but only 0.29 ATR above the 50SMA, tighter to that line.

LPG.zh: 组内第 97 百分位，离 21EMA 0.57 ATR，今年 EPS +1264%。
LPG.en: 97th percentile in its group, 0.57 ATR from the 21EMA, EPS +1264% this year.

ANDG.zh: ⚠️ RS 评级 1，组内却是第 100 百分位，两个读数互相矛盾。先当数据问题查，别当候选。
ANDG.en: ⚠️ RS rating of 1 but 100th percentile in its group — the two readings contradict each other. Treat it as a data problem, not a candidate.

GTLB.zh: 几乎压在 21EMA 上（0.09 ATR），离高点 14.9%，营收 +21%。
GTLB.en: Sitting almost right on the 21EMA (0.09 ATR), 14.9% off its high, revenue +21%.

NSIT.zh: 压在 21EMA 上（0.01 ATR），今天全部候选里回踩最深；离高点 7.2%，今年 EPS +76%。
NSIT.en: Pinned to the 21EMA (0.01 ATR), the deepest pullback of all today's candidates; 7.2% off its high, EPS +76% this year.

STX.zh: RS 98、今年 EPS +149%；离 21EMA 0.96 ATR 贴着回踩区间上沿，离高点 19.3%。
STX.en: RS 98, EPS +149% this year; 0.96 ATR from the 21EMA, at the top edge of the pullback band, 19.3% off its high.

TGB.zh: 组内第 88 百分位，离 21EMA 0.51 ATR，一个月 +5.6%。
TGB.en: 88th percentile in its group, 0.51 ATR from the 21EMA, up 5.6% in a month.

PRCH.zh: 一个月 −4%，离 21EMA 只有 0.1 ATR，组内第 91 百分位，今年 EPS +155%。
PRCH.en: Down 4% in a month, only 0.1 ATR above the 21EMA, 91st percentile in its group, EPS +155% this year.

TH.zh: 几乎压在 21EMA 上（0.08 ATR），一个月 +9.1%，离高点 9.4%。
TH.en: Almost pinned to the 21EMA (0.08 ATR), up 9.1% in a month, 9.4% off its high.

KSS.zh: 离 52 周高 24.6%，今天所有候选里离高点最远、紧贴 §11.1 的 25% 线；离 50SMA 只 0.27 ATR。
KSS.en: 24.6% off its 52-week high — the furthest of all today's candidates, right at §11.1's 25% line; just 0.27 ATR above the 50SMA.

IDT.zh: 离 52 周高只差 0.8%，组内第 98 百分位；离 21EMA 3.56 ATR、离 50SMA 4.39 ATR，已过 4 ATR 上限。
IDT.en: Only 0.8% off its 52-week high, 98th percentile in its group; 3.56 ATR above the 21EMA and 4.39 ATR above the 50SMA — past the 4 ATR edge.

KOD.zh: 一个月 +155.8%，离 21EMA 6.56 ATR、离 50SMA 7.6 ATR，今天最伸展的一只；日波幅 9%。
KOD.en: Up 155.8% in a month, 6.56 ATR above the 21EMA and 7.6 ATR above the 50SMA — the most extended name today; 9% daily range.

ROG.zh: 今天跳 +10.7%，一个月 +24.4%；离 21EMA 2.67 ATR、离 50SMA 3.25 ATR，离高点 9.5%。
ROG.en: Gapped +10.7% today, up 24.4% in a month; 2.67 ATR above the 21EMA and 3.25 ATR above the 50SMA, 9.5% off its high.
